title: Dalton Saffe
description: Dalton Saffe is an artist & software engineer based in Brooklyn, NY. They've been painting, DJing, producing music, and organizing events since their teen years in Miami. They studied graphic design at the School of Visual Arts, worked in the service industry, and as an apprentice naturopath before learning to write software in 2017 and attending Fullstack Academy in 2018. Since then, they've gone on to work as a full-stack engineer at design agencies, Leafly, & Trade Coffee.
emailListBlurb: Occasional updates on new art and blog posts :)
